subtasks.description: Declare the module's registers (offset[8:0], wb_free, reset_rx_fifo, rd, state), wires (fifo_q[31:0], fifo_full, fifo_empty), and parameter MEM_OFFSET as specified in the interface and register descriptions.
Instantiate sd_rx_fifo submodule and connect ports: d=dat_i, wr=wr, wclk=sd_clk, q=fifo_q, rd=rd, full=fifo_full, empty=fifo_empty, rclk=clk, rst=reset_rx_fifo; optionally tie off mem_empt.

Generate all Wishbone master outputs combinationally: m_wb_adr_o = adr + offset, m_wb_dat_o = fifo_q, m_wb_we_o/cyc_o/stb_o driven by wb_request_active, assign constant values to m_wb_cti_o and m_wb_bte_o, connect full/empty to fifo_full/fifo_empty.
constraints: All Wishbone outputs must be purely combinational; no registers inserted in this block.
Assign classic single-cycle Wishbone constants to m_wb_cti_o and m_wb_bte_o.

subtasks.description: Implement the control FSM with a single clocked always block, asynchronous reset, two states (IDLE, ACTIVE). Manage offset increment, wb_free, reset_rx_fifo, rd, state transitions per spec, and generate wb_request_active = (state == ACTIVE).
constraints: Use a single always block with asynchronous reset; no multi-cycle delays or additional pipeline stages.
Decode state using localparam for IDLE and ACTIVE; ensure reset and disable behavior exactly follows the spec.
